نبذة

At Lux Nail Bar & Head Spa in Sherwood, indulgence meets expert care with a range of premium manicure and pedicure services tailored for every client. Specialties like the Russian Pedicure and luxurious gel polish touch-ups ensure nails are always in top condition, while the welcoming atmosphere makes it a perfect spot for families. With convenient access and thoughtful amenities, it's a place where beauty and comfort come together seamlessly.

التعليقات

74

A welcoming, relaxing character runs through Lux Sherwood, where clients appreciate the friendly team and attentive care. Head spa treatments and pedicures stand out, with nail technicians taking time to understand the desired result and consider natural nail health; guests also enjoy thoughtful touches such as warm tea, leaving appointments feeling pampered and pleased with their nails.
